title: Apprendre le Madison en 5 minutes (Tutoriel Débutant)

observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The teacher provides clear, step-by-step instructions with a focus on weight transfer and arm positioning. He uses a mirror to demonstrate the steps, allowing students to follow along easily.

lesson_structure.note: The teacher introduces the Madison dance.
The teacher explains the structure of the dance.
The teacher breaks down the first 8 counts.
The teacher breaks down the second 8 counts.
The teacher demonstrates the full dance without variations.
The teacher explains the first variation.
The teacher explains the second variation.
The teacher demonstrates the full dance with variations.

metaphors: imaginez qu'il y a une ligne à votre droite
safety: gardez les bras plus haut que le niveau de la taille

steps_taught.name: base latérale
steps_taught.description: trois pas latéraux sur le côté

steps_taught.name: kick

steps_taught.name: pointé

what_works: The teacher breaks down the dance into two 8-count segments.
The use of a mirror makes it easy to follow along.
what_hinders: The video is fast-paced, which might be challenging for absolute beginners.

evidence_segments.observation: The teacher stands in front of a mirror and speaks directly to the camera.
The teacher demonstrates the lateral step by moving to the right.
The teacher demonstrates the kick by lifting his knee.
The teacher demonstrates the backward step.
The teacher demonstrates the point step.

extraction.distinctive_method: The teacher uses a mirror to demonstrate the steps, which is a common but effective method for teaching dance.
